steps.tx: **EBV with CMV** are ubiquitous herpesviruses causing **mononucleosis syndromes**; HHV-6 with 7 cause roseola, HHV-8 causes Kaposi sarcoma. **EBV gives heterophile-positive** mono in teens; **CMV gives heterophile-negative** mono at any age. **Latency for life** with reactivation under immunosuppression defines the family. **Transplant with HIV** converts silent carriage into retinitis, colitis and lymphoma. **Atypical lymphocytes** flag both.
steps.say: E B V with C M V were defined as ubiquitous herpesviruses causing mononucleosis syndromes, while H H V six with seven caused roseola and H H V eight caused Kaposi sarcoma. E B V was reported to give heterophile-positive mono in teens, while C M V gave heterophile-negative mono at any age. Latency for life with reactivation under immunosuppression was reported to define the family. Transplant with H I V was reported to convert silent carriage into retinitis, colitis and lymphoma. Atypical lymphocytes were reported to flag both.

steps.tx: **Fever with sore throat with nodes** for weeks with **palatal petechiae** marks EBV mono in adolescents. **Posterior cervical nodes with splenomegaly** with atypical lymphocytes completes it. **Ampicillin rash** after a mistaken strep prescription is classic, not allergy. **Heterophile (Monospot) turns positive** in the second week; early negatives repeat. **CMV mono mimics** without pharyngitis or nodes, with prolonged fever in pregnancy.
steps.say: Fever with sore throat and nodes for weeks with palatal petechiae was reported to mark E B V mono in adolescents. Posterior cervical nodes with splenomegaly and atypical lymphocytes were reported to complete it. Ampicillin rash after a mistaken strep prescription was defined as classic, not allergy. Heterophile Monospot was reported to turn positive in the second week, while early negatives were repeated. C M V mono was reported to mimic without pharyngitis or nodes, with prolonged fever in pregnancy.

steps.tx: **Splenic rupture** threatens in the first month; **contact sports with lifting** wait a month. **Airway obstruction** from tonsillar swelling needs steroids with admission. **Autoimmune haemolysis with low platelets** complicates rarely. **Chronic active EBV** with HLH kills without transplant. **Burkitt with nasopharyngeal cancer with PTLD** are EBV lymphomas to remember. **X-linked lymphoproliferative** boys die of primary EBV.
steps.say: Splenic rupture was reported to threaten in the first month, while contact sports with lifting waited a month. Airway obstruction from tonsillar swelling was reported to need steroids with admission. Autoimmune haemolysis with low platelets was reported to complicate rarely. Chronic active E B V with H L H was reported to kill without transplant. Burkitt with nasopharyngeal cancer and P T L D were defined as E B V lymphomas to remember. X-linked lymphoproliferative boys were reported to die of primary E B V.

steps.tx: **CMV colitis with retinitis** strikes transplant with AIDS below 50: **pizza-pie retinitis** blinds painlessly, **bloody diarrhoea** marks colitis. **Pneumonitis with encephalitis** follows intense immunosuppression. **Congenital CMV** deafens: 40 to 50% of symptomatic neonates develop sensorineural loss. **Transfused with donor organs** transmit; **leukodepleted blood** protects neonates. **Ganciclovir-resistant UL97** emerges on prolonged exposure.
steps.say: C M V colitis with retinitis was reported to strike transplant with A I D S below fifty, as painless pizza-pie retinitis blinded and bloody diarrhoea marked colitis. Pneumonitis with encephalitis was reported to follow intense immunosuppression. Congenital C M V was reported to deafen, as forty to fifty percent of symptomatic neonates developed sensorineural loss. Transfused blood with donor organs was reported to transmit, while leukodepleted blood protected neonates. Ganciclovir-resistant U L ninety seven was reported to emerge on prolonged exposure.

steps.tx: **Roseola strikes toddlers**: high fever for days then **rash as fever breaks**; HHV-6 with 7 cause it. **Febrile seizures** complicate the fever, not the rash. **Encephalitis in transplant** rarely follows HHV-6 reactivation. **Kaposi purple plaques** with visceral spread mark HHV-8 with unsuppressed HIV. **Primary effusion lymphoma with Castleman** are HHV-8 tumours beyond skin. **ART with chemo** treats Kaposi with immunity.
steps.say: Roseola was reported to strike toddlers as high fever for days then rash as fever broke, while H H V six with seven caused it. Febrile seizures were reported to complicate the fever, not the rash. Encephalitis in transplant was rarely reported to follow H H V six reactivation. Kaposi purple plaques with visceral spread were reported to mark H H V eight with unsuppressed H I V. Primary effusion lymphoma with Castleman were defined as H H V eight tumours beyond skin. A R T with chemo was reported to treat Kaposi with immunity.

steps.tx: **Atypical lymphocytes over 10%** with **positive heterophile** diagnoses EBV mono; **liver enzymes rise** modestly. **EBV VCA IgM** proves acute infection; **EBNA marks past** infection. **Heterophile-negative mono** with pregnancy or transfusion points to CMV or toxo. **Amylase with LFTs** exclude mumps with hepatitis mimics. **Lymphoma needs biopsy**; serology never proves tumour.
steps.say: Atypical lymphocytes over ten percent with positive heterophile were ordered to diagnose E B V mono, while liver enzymes rose modestly. E B V V C A I g M was reported to prove acute infection, while E B N A marked past infection. Heterophile-negative mono with pregnancy or transfusion was reported to point to C M V or toxo. Amylase with L F Ts was ordered to exclude mumps with hepatitis mimics. Lymphoma was reported to need biopsy, as serology never proved tumour.

steps.tx: **CMV PCR in blood** stages transplant infection; **pp65 antigen** is older. **Retinitis needs fundoscopy**, not blood alone; **colitis needs biopsy** with owl-eye inclusions. **Congenital diagnosis is saliva PCR at birth**; later positives cannot separate congenital from acquired. **Ganciclovir resistance (UL97)** is tested when load rises on therapy. **Donor-recipient serostatus** stratifies transplant prophylaxis.
steps.say: C M V P C R in blood was ordered to stage transplant infection, while pp sixty five antigen stayed older. Retinitis was reported to need fundoscopy, not blood alone, while colitis needed biopsy with owl-eye inclusions. Congenital diagnosis with saliva P C R at birth was ordered, as later positives could not separate congenital from acquired. Ganciclovir resistance U L ninety seven was tested when load rose on therapy. Donor-recipient serostatus was reported to stratify transplant prophylaxis.

steps.tx: **EBV mono needs no antivirals**; rest with fluids with time cures. **Steroids only for obstruction, haemolysis or low platelets**; routine steroids prolong shedding. **Avoid ampicillin** once mono suspected; rash alarms falsely. **No sport for a month** protects the spleen. **Acyclovir never shortens** mono; ganciclovir is not for EBV. **HLH with chronic active** disease goes to transplant centres fast.
steps.say: E B V mono was reported to need no antivirals, as rest with fluids and time cured. Steroids were reserved only for obstruction, haemolysis or low platelets, while routine steroids prolonged shedding. ampicillin was avoided once mono was suspected, as rash alarmed falsely. Sport was avoided for a month to protect the spleen. Acyclovir was reported to never shorten mono, while ganciclovir was not advised for E B V. H L H with chronic active disease was sent to transplant centres fast.

steps.tx: **Ganciclovir 5 mg/kg IV twice daily for 14 to 21 days** induces severe CMV, then **valganciclovir 900 mg daily** suppresses. **Valganciclovir 900 mg twice daily** treats moderate disease orally. **Foscarnet covers UL97 resistance** with renal watching; **cidofovir 5 mg/kg** is last line with probenecid. **Prophylaxis with valganciclovir** shields D-positive grafts. **Congenital symptomatic** disease earns 6 months valganciclovir to save hearing.
steps.say: Ganciclovir at five milligrams per kilo I V twice daily for fourteen to twenty one days was ordered to induce severe C M V, then valganciclovir at nine hundred milligrams daily suppressed. Valganciclovir at nine hundred milligrams twice daily was reported to treat moderate disease orally. Foscarnet was reported to cover U L ninety seven resistance with renal watching, while cidofovir at five milligrams per kilo stayed last line with probenecid. Prophylaxis with valganciclovir was reported to shield D-positive grafts. Congenital symptomatic disease was reported to earn six months valganciclovir to save hearing.

steps.tx: **Exam traps:** heterophile-negative mono is still mono (CMV, toxo). **Ampicillin rash means mono**, not penicillin allergy for life. **Normal throat with prolonged fever** in pregnancy is CMV till proved otherwise. **Ganciclovir for EBV mono** never helps. **Sport at 2 weeks** ruptures healing spleens. **Maribavir treats resistance**, not first episodes; **letermovir prevents**, not treats.
steps.say: For the exam, these traps were tabulated as requested. Heterophile-negative mono was reported to stay mono from C M V or toxo. Ampicillin rash was reported to mean mono, not penicillin allergy for life. Normal throat with prolonged fever in pregnancy was reported to stay C M V till proved otherwise. Ganciclovir for E B V mono was reported to never help. Sport at two weeks was reported to rupture healing spleens. Maribavir was reported to treat resistance, not first episodes, while letermovir prevented but never treated.

steps.tx: **High yield for the exam:** **heterophile-positive teens** mark EBV; **heterophile-negative** marks CMV. **Atypical cells with nodes** diagnose mono; **ampicillin rash** confirms suspicion. **Pizza-pie retina below 50** needs **ganciclovir 5 mg/kg twice daily**. **No antivirals for EBV**; **steroids only if blocked**. **Congenital deafness** needs saliva PCR **at birth**.
steps.say: For the exam, these high-yield facts were tabulated as requested. Heterophile-positive teens were reported to mark E B V, while heterophile-negative marked C M V. Atypical cells with nodes were reported to diagnose mono, while ampicillin rash confirmed suspicion. Pizza-pie retina below fifty was reported to need ganciclovir at five milligrams per kilo twice daily. No antivirals for E B V were advised, while steroids were reserved only if blocked. Congenital deafness was reported to need saliva P C R at birth.
